section_summary.extract_value: This section reports data from a single sample of 228 undergraduate Black female college students at a large urban Mid-Atlantic university (M age = 19.89, SD = 4.57). Mean BMI was 24.71 (SD = 6.04); measures were administered online via SONA Systems and participants were recruited from a Psychology 101 participant pool and other psychology courses. The section does not label the study as 'Study 1' or similar and does not report BAS/BAS-2 assessment or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
